_comment: Issue #4424 — shard-chain dispatch pacing. One source for the numbers the options chain dispatcher uses; no module hardcodes them. inFlightCap: shards released in the initial burst of one chain dispatch; paceIntervalMs: spacing between the shards released after that burst (dispatch-rate backpressure); staggerMs: spacing between shard starts inside the burst (the value the dispatcher previously hardcoded as 1000).
